B_total_nT.note: formula: |B| = sqrt(Be^2 + Bn^2 + Bu^2) from the IGRF model at geodetic lat, lon, altitude and time; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.lat, iss_hotspots.equatorial.lon, iss_hotspots.equatorial.alt_km, iss_hotspots.equatorial.as_of

shielding_factor.note: field outside the sensor divided by the field at the sensor

B_at_sensor_nT.note: formula: B_at_sensor = |B| / shielding_factor; inputs: locations.iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, inputs.shielding_factor; field left at the sensor after the stated shield; the OPM requirement checks it against the on-board compensation limit

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).
radiation_context.source: George et al. (2024), 'Space radiation measurements during the Artemis I lunar mission', Nature 634, 48-52, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07927-7 (abstract); Golightly, Weyland, Johnson & Semones (2001), 'Twenty Years of Radiation Measurements in Low-Earth Orbit', NASA JSC-CN-6928, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20100029831 (abstract)

coords.source: SGP4 (python sgp4 2.27) propagation of the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544 (ISS (ZARYA)), TLE epoch 2026-11-15T08:02:34Z, https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?CATNR=25544&FORMAT=TLE
coords.note: formula: SGP4 propagation to as_of, then TEME -> Earth-fixed by GMST and WGS84 geodetic conversion; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.tle (retrieved 2026-11-15T19:53:33Z, sha256 ca58416e03d7...)

shielding_factor.note: field outside the sensor divided by the field at the sensor

snr_required.note: signal-to-noise ratio (amplitude) the measurement must reach

bilirubin_isf.note: bilirubin in skin interstitial fluid, in the unit of the patch's stated range

brain_signal_fT.source: data/recorded/opm_brain_mne.json (MNE-Python OPM sample dataset, OPM_SEF_raw.fif; evoked average)
brain_signal_fT.note: formula: max over channels and samples at t > 0 s of |evoked B|; inputs: recorded/opm_brain_mne.json evoked.series (8 OPM channels), evoked.x; peak on channel MEG1231 at 0.08 s after the median-nerve stimulus; recorded 2018-04-26 on Earth, not an astronaut

brain_trials.note: formula: count of stimulus-locked epochs that passed rejection, averaged into the evoked response; inputs: recorded/opm_brain_mne.json

nv_bandwidth_hz.source: Omar et al., 'Human Cardiac Measurements with Diamond Magnetometers', arXiv 2601.18843v1 (Jan 2026), https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.18843 (Section 3.1, p. 10)
nv_bandwidth_hz.note: upgraded from TO_CONFIRM on 2026-11-15: p. 10, 'a bandwidth of approximately 30 Hz' (stored as 30; the paper says approximately); the same sentence gives a single-shot RMS noise floor of 50 pT

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

B_total_nT.source: IGRF-14 (ppigrf 2.1.0, IGRF14.shc); position from SGP4 on the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544
B_total_nT.note: formula: |B| = sqrt(Be^2 + Bn^2 + Bu^2) from the IGRF model at geodetic lat, lon, altitude and time; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.lat, iss_hotspots.equatorial.lon, iss_hotspots.equatorial.alt_km, iss_hotspots.equatorial.as_of

shielding_factor.note: field outside the sensor divided by the field at the sensor

B_at_sensor_nT.note: formula: B_at_sensor = |B| / shielding_factor; inputs: locations.iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, inputs.shielding_factor; field left at the sensor after the stated shield; the OPM requirement checks it against the on-board compensation limit

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).
radiation_context.source: George et al. (2024), 'Space radiation measurements during the Artemis I lunar mission', Nature 634, 48-52, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07927-7 (abstract); Golightly, Weyland, Johnson & Semones (2001), 'Twenty Years of Radiation Measurements in Low-Earth Orbit', NASA JSC-CN-6928, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20100029831 (abstract)

coords.source: SGP4 (python sgp4 2.27) propagation of the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544 (ISS (ZARYA)), TLE epoch 2026-11-15T08:02:34Z, https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?CATNR=25544&FORMAT=TLE
coords.note: formula: SGP4 propagation to as_of, then TEME -> Earth-fixed by GMST and WGS84 geodetic conversion; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.tle (retrieved 2026-11-15T19:53:33Z, sha256 ca58416e03d7...)

B_vector_nT.axes: x north, y east, z down (local geodetic)
B_vector_nT.source: IGRF-14 (ppigrf 2.1.0, IGRF14.shc); position from SGP4 on the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544

used_by.opm: B_total_nT is B_ambient in the opm_field_nulled requirement (a null or non-VERIFIED field is sent to Lean as missing)
used_by.nv: nv_zeeman_shift_MHz: the line shift this background field alone causes; no Lean requirement uses it

used_by.cqd_patch: radiation_context only: no sourced requirement links the location to the bilirubin patch

requirements.note: A: peak |evoked field| after the stimulus in the MNE OPM recording (Earth, QuSpin OPMs). N: the recording's averaged epochs. η: the QZFM Gen-3 datasheet states the dual-axis sensitivity as '<15 fT/√Hz (3–100 Hz)'; the bound is used, so REQUIREMENTS_MET holds for any lower noise (holds_mono_lhs) and NOT_MET means not met at the bound. input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach

input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)

input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

shielding_factor.note: field outside the sensor divided by the field at the sensor

B_at_sensor_nT.note: formula: B_at_sensor = |B| / shielding_factor; inputs: locations.iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, inputs.shielding_factor; field left at the sensor after the stated shield; the OPM requirement checks it against the on-board compensation limit

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

B_total_nT.source: IGRF-14 (ppigrf 2.1.0, IGRF14.shc); position from SGP4 on the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544
B_total_nT.note: formula: |B| = sqrt(Be^2 + Bn^2 + Bu^2) from the IGRF model at geodetic lat, lon, altitude and time; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.lat, iss_hotspots.equatorial.lon, iss_hotspots.equatorial.alt_km, iss_hotspots.equatorial.as_of

shielding_factor.note: field outside the sensor divided by the field at the sensor

B_at_sensor_nT.note: formula: B_at_sensor = |B| / shielding_factor; inputs: locations.iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, inputs.shielding_factor; field left at the sensor after the stated shield; the OPM requirement checks it against the on-board compensation limit

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).
radiation_context.source: George et al. (2024), 'Space radiation measurements during the Artemis I lunar mission', Nature 634, 48-52, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07927-7 (abstract); Golightly, Weyland, Johnson & Semones (2001), 'Twenty Years of Radiation Measurements in Low-Earth Orbit', NASA JSC-CN-6928, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20100029831 (abstract)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield

input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

environment.opm_note: requires magnetic shielding / field nulling coils (QuSpin operates in a shielded or compensated environment)

ratio_to_earth_surface.note: formula: |B| / IGRF |B| at Johnson Space Center; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT, meta.reference.earth_surface_nT (earth_flight.jsc)

radiation_context.text: Low Earth orbit: the published radiation data from the International Space Station come from an orbit protected by heavy shielding and Earth's magnetic field (George et al. 2024). Trapped-proton exposure in low Earth orbit is modelled in the South Atlantic Anomaly region (Golightly et al. 2001). The live GOES proton flux and NOAA storm level are in /api/live (radiation).
radiation_context.source: George et al. (2024), 'Space radiation measurements during the Artemis I lunar mission', Nature 634, 48-52, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07927-7 (abstract); Golightly, Weyland, Johnson & Semones (2001), 'Twenty Years of Radiation Measurements in Low-Earth Orbit', NASA JSC-CN-6928, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20100029831 (abstract)

coords.source: SGP4 (python sgp4 2.27) propagation of the CelesTrak TLE for NORAD 25544 (ISS (ZARYA)), TLE epoch 2026-11-15T08:02:34Z, https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?CATNR=25544&FORMAT=TLE

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.

nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.source: SpinDrift calculation; 28.025 MHz/mT is the electron gyromagnetic ratio gamma_e/2pi (CODATA 2022, 28 024.951 3861 MHz/T, rounded to five digits; data/quantum_constants.json electron.gyromagnetic_ratio_over_2pi)
nv_zeeman_shift_MHz.note: formula: 28.025 MHz/mT x |B|; inputs: iss_hotspots.equatorial.B_total_nT; |B| in mT = nT x 1e-6; shift of one NV resonance line for a field along the NV axis (the two lines separate by twice this)

brain_signal_fT.source: data/recorded/opm_brain_mne.json (MNE-Python OPM sample dataset, OPM_SEF_raw.fif; evoked average)
brain_signal_fT.note: formula: max over channels and samples at t > 0 s of |evoked B|; inputs: recorded/opm_brain_mne.json evoked.series (8 OPM channels), evoked.x; peak on channel MEG1231 at 0.08 s after the median-nerve stimulus; recorded 2018-04-26 on Earth, not an astronaut

brain_trials.note: formula: count of stimulus-locked epochs that passed rejection, averaged into the evoked response; inputs: recorded/opm_brain_mne.json

nv_bandwidth_hz.source: Omar et al., 'Human Cardiac Measurements with Diamond Magnetometers', arXiv 2601.18843v1 (Jan 2026), https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.18843 (Section 3.1, p. 10)
nv_bandwidth_hz.note: upgraded from TO_CONFIRM on 2026-11-15: p. 10, 'a bandwidth of approximately 30 Hz' (stored as 30; the paper says approximately); the same sentence gives a single-shot RMS noise floor of 50 pT

input_units.shielding_factor: × (field outside ÷ field at the sensor); default 1, no shield
input_units.beats_averaged: heartbeats averaged (OPM heart and NV cards)
input_units.snr_required: amplitude signal-to-noise ratio the measurement must reach
input_units.target: r_peak or q_wave (heart cards; default r_peak)
input_units.renin: pM, the unit of the detection limit in Long et al. (2012); no conversion is made
input_units.bilirubin_isf: unit of the patch's detection range, which is not yet extracted from Tabatabaee et al. (2024); no conversion is made
input_units.bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the OPM cards (within 3–100 Hz, where the datasheet states the noise density); the NV cards use the paper's bandwidth unless nv_bandwidth_hz is given
input_units.brain_signal_fT: fT, the peak evoked brain field to detect (A of opm_snr_brain); optional, default the recorded peak |evoked field| of recorded/opm_brain_mne.json
input_units.brain_trials: trials, the stimulus-locked trials averaged (N of opm_snr_brain); optional, a positive whole number, default the recording's averaged epochs (n_epochs)
input_units.nv_bandwidth_hz: Hz, measurement bandwidth for the three NV cards (BW of nv_snr); optional, default specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed (the paper's approximately 30 Hz)

notes: Every holds value and verdict is Lean's output; Python only builds the input and formats the reply.
Measurability check only: not diagnostic and not medical advice.
